source_snapshot.procedure: Open Settings > User Management, select the account to be deleted and delete one user.
source_snapshot.criteria: The user is removed successfully and no longer appears in the user list.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL recognizes an operator-driven account write but conflates add/delete/modify, uses insecure partial readback and does not identify an immutable target, exclude protected accounts, distinguish removal from disablement, verify authentication/session denial or provide recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with CRITICAL risk correctly requires one disposable account, immutable ID/username correlation, complete account/session baseline, independent recovery, one approved WebUI deletion, full post-state/audit, denied login/session behavior and unrelated-account continuity.

old_problem: The source does not name the account, and a displayed username alone may select the wrong slot/identity. A row disappearing can be stale filtering or disablement rather than deletion; partial API readback cannot prove resource absence, credential denial, defined session behavior, unrelated-account preservation or recovery. The source's explicit removal objective should not be silently weakened to disable-only behavior.
disposition_reason: Bind the target to one separately approved disposable fixture using stable account/member identity and username, exclude every protected/recovery account, then perform one actual WebUI delete with visual evidence. PASS requires the account resource and list entry to be absent, new login denied, active sessions handled per pre-bound policy, all unrelated accounts unchanged and recovery intact. Target identity/session values are Project inputs; disable-only behavior is not accepted as deletion unless an approved bounded override records the remaining source gap.
decision_basis: XLSX row 937, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, adjacent Add/Modify-User rows and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed; row 938 and its manifest identity were independently verified.

The source Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently say delete/remove and no longer show the user; therefore disappearance plus resource absence, not a disabled flag alone, is the Review-layer acceptance.
ED-20/ED-23 require actual WebUI visual evidence with API corroboration, and ED-35 prohibits replacing the functional delete with read-only or disable coverage.
DMTF ManagerAccount collection/member identity provides a structured way to prove exact resource removal and unrelated-account preservation, while session invalidation remains a target policy input.

test_case.test_name: Delete one immutable disposable WebUI account and prove resource, login and session post-state
test_case.purpose: Verify that the BMC WebUI deletes exactly one approved disposable account identified by stable account/member ID and username, removes it from every complete UI/API inventory, denies new authentication, applies the approved existing-session policy, preserves all unrelated/protected accounts and independent recovery, and returns to the fixture-excluded golden baseline.
required_package: Target BMC/firmware/WebUI build and supported AccountService/ManagerAccount deletion and session semantics
One pre-created non-production disposable local account with immutable member ID/slot, username, role and protected credential, plus proof it is not a recovery/protected identity
Two baselines: golden inventory before fixture creation and complete pre-delete inventory including exactly that fixture, with roles/states/sessions
Project rule for deletion versus disablement and existing-session revoke/retain timing; source PASS requires actual resource removal
Complete trusted paginated UI/API inventory, security audit and bounded login/session verification method
Independent local-admin/console recovery, exact one-delete approval and approved recreation only if the final state must include the fixture
test_case.test_command: CRITICAL ACCOUNT DELETION; DO NOT EXECUTE WITHOUT POINT-OF-ACTION APPROVAL. Preserve logs, verify target/recovery and capture the golden and pre-delete account/role/session baselines. Correlate one disposable WebUI row to exactly one immutable API member ID/slot and username; stop on ambiguity, duplicate display name, protected/recovery role or critical active session. A human/operator opens Settings > User Management, visually selects that exact account and performs one delete while capturing confirmation and result. Collect complete trusted UI/API/session inventories and audit evidence. Prove the member resource is absent (not merely disabled/filtered), the username cannot start a new session, any pre-existing test session follows the approved invalidation rule, and every unrelated/protected account/session remains unchanged. Compare to the fixture-excluded golden baseline. Recreate only under a separate explicit rollback/final-state approval. Do not bulk-delete, clear logs, terminate recovery sessions or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly the disposable account's UI row and ManagerAccount member resource are absent; no hidden/disabled duplicate or orphan slot remains. New login with its credential is denied, its named existing session is retained or revoked exactly as target policy specifies, and no unrelated account, role, slot or protected session changes. Independent local administration remains available, audit evidence identifies the exact deletion, and the final inventory equals the approved fixture-excluded golden baseline (or a separately approved exact recreation is proven).
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target correlation, actual human WebUI delete evidence, complete resource/list absence, denied new login, approved existing-session result, full unrelated/protected-account equality, local recovery and golden/final-state reconciliation. UI success/toast, row disappearance, HTTP status or disablement alone cannot pass. Wrong/ambiguous/protected account, residual resource, continued new login, unexpected session survival/revocation, unrelated change, secret exposure, recovery impact or inability to reach the approved final state is FAIL and stops. Missing disposable target/policy/recovery/approval is NOT READY.
safety_gate: Delete only a verified disposable non-production account by stable ID plus username; never select by display name alone or touch protected/admin recovery identities.
Maintain independent local-admin/console recovery and complete golden/pre-delete baselines; never delete the only administrator or terminate the recovery session.
Actual WebUI visual selection/confirmation evidence is mandatory; API-only deletion or readback cannot substitute for source coverage.
Protect credentials and account metadata; do not use `curl -k`, expose secrets, bulk-delete, delete directory-side identities or clear security logs.
Execute one delete only. Stop on ambiguity, timeout, unexpected account/session change or access loss; do not retry or silently accept disable-only behavior.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/firmware/WebUI identity, disposable/protected classification, immutable member ID/slot+username and independent recovery proof
Golden inventory and complete pre-delete UI/API/role/session baseline including exactly the fixture
Human WebUI selected-account/confirmation/result visuals and one correlated security audit event
Complete post-delete UI/API absence, new-login denial, approved existing-session behavior and unrelated/protected-account equality
Fixture-excluded golden final comparison or separately approved exact recreation, preserved logs/no secret exposure and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If the wrong account is selected/deleted, the target remains partially present, session behavior is unsafe or unrelated access changes, stop without another delete. Use independent local-admin/console recovery to recreate only the exact saved disposable account if approved, restore its role/state, reconcile the entire inventory and sessions, preserve audit evidence and rotate test credentials. Never bulk-recreate or alter protected users.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require actual deletion/removal of one account. Target identity and session behavior are parameterized readiness inputs; disable-only behavior is an explicit coverage gap, not a conflicting source purpose.

blocked.reason: The exact delete, visual/electronic evidence, authentication/session acceptance and recovery are defined. A disposable account and target policy can be supplied safely.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Target delete/session semantics; one immutable disposable account; golden/pre-delete inventories; protected-account list; trusted UI/API evidence; recovery and one-delete/final-state approvals.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; CRITICAL WEBUI ACCOUNT DELETE; POINT-OF-ACTION APPROVAL REQUIRED; NO ACCOUNT OR SESSION STATE CHANGED
